notes: Rules: analysis-cases.md. Synthetic songs are rendered once by scripts/analysis_signals.mjs (spelled out in its comments) at 44100 Hz, the beat model's 22050 Hz input made from that render by its fixed resampler (half), and checked against the truth they were built from (CI). Real songs are decoded into the local cache and checked side against side (layer 1), then planned (layer 2); their audio is never committed.

synthetic.name: click-120
synthetic.what: an accented click track: tempo, beats and the bar start in the clearest case

synthetic.name: drums-128-late-start
synthetic.what: a drum kit starting 1.25 s in: the grid must not start in the silence

synthetic.name: drums-174
synthetic.what: fast drum and bass tempo: no half-time reading

synthetic.name: drums-80
synthetic.what: slow tempo: no double-time reading (was drums-85 until 2026-11-19: its beats passed by one point only, 96%)

synthetic.name: drums-85
synthetic.what: slow tempo, off the beat model's 20 ms frames (0.706 s a beat): no double-time reading, every beat found. Back on 2026-11-19 with the 25 ms tolerance (100% beats; 96% at 20 ms)

knownMiss.downbeat: 2026-11-19: the extension's analyser puts the bar start half a bar late here (1.92 s for 0.50 s), every bar; drums-80 and drums-90 get theirs right. Kept as found: neither analyser is tuned to these cases.

synthetic.name: drums-90
synthetic.what: 90 BPM, off the beat model's frames (0.667 s a beat), starting off a frame (0.5 s): every beat and the bar start found. Added 2026-11-19 with the 25 ms tolerance (it failed at 20 ms by a ms)

synthetic.name: tempo-change-120-126
synthetic.what: 120 BPM, then 126 BPM (5%) from 24.5 s: the beats follow both parts (one tempo can't describe the song, so tempo isn't checked). Was 100 then 110 until 2026-11-19: it passed by 0 and 1 point on the spec's own render and failed on any other resample

synthetic.name: tempo-change-100-110
synthetic.what: 100 BPM, then 110 BPM (10%) from 24.5 s: the bar count runs on across the jump. Only the downbeat is checked: the beats pass at 97% with 25 ms, under the 3-point margin

knownMiss.downbeat: 2026-11-19: the extension's analyser loses a beat 3 to 5 s after the jump (27.2, 27.8 and 29.4 s land 160 to 520 ms off), so every 4th beat after it is half a bar off: 59% of bars. Kept as found.

synthetic.name: voice-section
synthetic.what: a click track with a voice-like tone from 22.2 s to 44.4 s: the vocal curve marks that section sung and nothing else

synthetic.name: no-voice
synthetic.what: drums alone (noise snares and hats): no section is marked sung

knownMiss.vocals: 2026-11-19: Open-Unmix (vocals_umxhq_int8) puts about 29% of these frames at 0.25 or more; noise bursts read as voice frame by frame. Kept as found; both sides run the same model.

synthetic.name: voice-over-chord
synthetic.what: the voice tone over a click track and an A minor chord pad: a held chord isn't a voice, the voice still is

knownMiss.vocals: 2026-11-19: Open-Unmix (vocals_umxhq_int8) reads the held sine chord as voice too: 92% of frames sung, IoU 54%. Kept as found; both sides run the same model.

synthetic.name: too-long-481
synthetic.what: a song over 8 minutes (481 s): not analysed, reported as too long and not as a failure (versions.md "Analysis length"). Not rendered: the check is the length alone

real.cache: decoded songs: <cache>/<videoId>.wav, 44100 Hz, 2 channels, 32-bit float, made with: ffmpeg -i <the song's audio> -ar 44100 -ac 2 -c:a pcm_f32le <videoId>.wav. Each side resamples it for its beat model in its own way. Results: <cache>/<side>/<videoId>.json, the analysis fields of analysis.schema.json.
real.songs: every song of pairs/*.json (by its id), plus the ones listed here

thresholds.name: LOOP_MARGIN
thresholds.where: automix.js loopOrBlend: the loop plays unless the blend scores this much more

thresholds.name: key score
thresholds.metric: the pair's key score (both keys trusted)
thresholds.where: automix.js keyScore: under it, Automix v2 picks a short blend

thresholds.name: V2_SUB_BASS_VETO
thresholds.where: automix.js subBassContrast: at or over it the two productions are never overlapped
